checks.description: Initialize is idempotent and replaces only the old transparent bridge
The first open shows one menu and records one animation
One hundred trigger re-entries never restart the open animation
Button hit regions stay fixed below the trigger band
The original trigger band has no menu hit target
The two actions occupy distinct radial angles
Leaving schedules the 175 millisecond close timer
Entering either shared region cancels a pending close
The crossing grace period does not close early
A pointer and focus outside both regions closes after the grace period
A later explicit open animates once and both actions become visible
Busy work cannot open the menu
Dispose releases the timer and prevents delayed reopening
